1|# Second Generation – Book Specification
     2|
     3|## Overview
     4|- **Title**: *Second Generation* (working title)
     5|- **Genre**: Science Fiction / Space Opera / Political Drama
     6|- **Setting**: Mars colony, near-future (circa 2075-2120) - 50 years after First Generation
     7|- **Core Theme**: The struggle for self-governance of a mature Martian civilization when Earth attempts to reassert control, exploring themes of independence, identity, and what it means to be Martian.
     8|
     9|## Core Questions
    10|**Book Two "the second generation" asks:** Can a Martian civilization govern itself when Earth returns not as rescuer, but as owner?
    11|
    12|## Tone
    13|**Primary tone:** Politically sharp, technologically mature, culturally rich, diplomatically tense, yet grounded in human experience.
